metadata.description: Google tooling for Claude Code: the Antigravity CLI bridge, Workspace skills, and Google's MCP servers split into small opt-in bundles.

plugins.name: agy
plugins.description: Use Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) from Claude Code: ask Gemini, delegate tasks, get second-opinion code reviews.

plugins.name: google
plugins.description: Google Workspace skills, auth bootstrap and a catalogue of Google's MCP servers. Ships no MCP servers of its own — /google:mcp enables them per project.

plugins.name: google-workspace-recipes
plugins.description: Ready-made Google Workspace workflows: 41 recipe-* task templates and 10 persona-* role playbooks. Needs the `google` plugin for the underlying gws-* capabilities.

plugins.name: google-cloud-mcp
plugins.description: The cheap Google Cloud MCP servers: gcloud, Cloud Run, Resource Manager and Developer Knowledge. ~57 KB of schema — small enough to leave on.

plugins.name: google-marketing-mcp
plugins.description: Google Ads, Analytics (GA4) and Search Console over MCP. Prompts for its credentials at install time; nothing is stored in this repo.

plugins.name: google-data-mcp
plugins.description: BigQuery plus the MCP Toolbox for Databases. ~133 KB of schema per session — enable it per project, not globally.
